requirement_text.REQ-001a: i18n mechanism (dependency, routing, proxy/middleware, working switcher) using only src/app/layout.tsx's strings as the seed catalog. 5 acceptance criteria: (1) /uz -> <html lang="uz">, /ru or / -> <html lang="ru">; (2) switcher click-through navigates ru<->uz preserving section anchors; (3) next-intl is a dependency, npm run build clean; (4) messages/ru.json and messages/uz.json have matching key sets, every uz value non-empty; (5) switcher offers exactly RU/UZ (no EN), only existing .lang classes, no new hex/spacing.

task.description: Independently re-verify REQ-001a per WF-02 Step 5 — do NOT trust TEST-RUNNER's report alone. (1) Re-run npm run lint && npm run build yourself. (2) TEST-RUNNER logged 2 non-blocking issues: ISSUE-1, no browser tool was available to it so AC2's click-through was substituted with server/source/CSS evidence — you likely have the same constraint, but at minimum spot-check by starting the server yourself and re-running at least 2-3 of the curl-based checks with your own commands, don't just re-read the report; ISSUE-2, the test spec's literal grep pattern over-matches on a real page (POSIX greedy .*) — confirm this is genuinely a spec-wording issue and not masking a real defect, by running your own equivalent check. (3) Confirm every one of REQ-001a's 5 acceptance criteria is satisfied against the actual current code/rendered output, not against TEST-RUNNER's summary. (4) Check docs/agents/requirements.yaml for staleness relative to what actually shipped (does REQ-001a's description still match reality, or did FRONTEND-DEV's implementation deviate in a way requirements.yaml doesn't reflect — note FRONTEND-DEV reported 4 deviations already reviewed and accepted by REVIEWER; confirm requirements.yaml doesn't need updating to reflect them, or if it does, flag it).
acceptance_criteria: npm run lint && npm run build re-run independently, real output quoted
At least 2-3 verification cases re-run with your own commands, not just re-reading the test report
All 5 acceptance criteria explicitly confirmed against actual code/output
requirements.yaml staleness check performed and stated
